full_track.tags: K-Pop Hip-Hop track featuring a male rapper with a rhythmic, laid-back delivery. The arrangement is built around a clean, plucked acoustic guitar loop playing a repetitive minor-key progression. A steady boom-bap drum pattern consists of a punchy kick, a crisp snare on the backbeat, and consistent eighth-note hi-hats. A subtle sub-bass follows the kick drum pattern. The tempo is 90 BPM in the key of G Minor. The production is dry with minimal reverb on the vocals and instruments, maintaining an intimate, close-mic sound. The vocal performance follows a steady flow with occasional melodic inflections at the end of phrases.
